overview: The City Council and Community Development Board convened for a special joint meeting that was immediately continued due to a lack of quorum.

items.title: Continuation of Public Hearing on Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District
items.summary: The public hearing regarding the Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District was continued to June 3, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. because neither the City Council nor the Community Development Board reached a quorum.
